answer: Give each agent one bonded identity slot: a deposit slashed if two slots are shown to share a controller through overlapping signatures or payout graphs. Voting weight cannot jump to a zenith in a single epoch; it grows only after repeated, independently countersigned work. If a vertex in the identity graph has many inbound bonds from one cluster, freeze those slots. An orchard of throwaway keys then fails, because each extra leaf needs a fresh unrecoverable deposit while influence stays capped per root.
